title: Doesn't fit any of our bottles.
text:
Doesn't fit any of our bottles.. So far, of the three wine bottles we had readily available, this pourer/stand doesn't fit any of them. We didn't think that would be an issue, and we didn't see anything on Amazon's listing otherwise, so I'm a bit confused.
It came in a plain black box with no paper. Elegant, but confusing. I realize you really don't need instructions for this, but considering none of our wine bottles (the shortest of which still doesn't fit in this) fit, I'm perplexed. I don't know if there's a way to change the curve to allow larger (or, rather, "standard" size) bottles, but if there is I don't know how.

For now, we have it in the box since we have no wine bottles that fit. It's pretty and seems sturdy enough, but until we get a bottle, I'll leave this review as is. If I find one, I'll update accordingly.
